correctness.rationale: A complete 256-form F2-vector-space enumeration using the exact surjectivity-of-degree-ten-ideal-piece smoothness criterion finds 24 geometrically smooth forms. Exhaustive compatibility testing of every pair and direct PGL3(F2) substitution gives exactly eight disjoint pencils, one orbit, group stabilizer 21, common curve stabilizer 7. Independent conjugation-based binary matrix enumeration reproduces 48 irreducible matrices and eight pencils. Bézout and Singer-group orbit arguments prove the rational and cubic-point intersection multiplicities (7*1+3*3=16), not merely finite point counts. Source code and outputs are embedded.

value.rationale: The exact classification concerns a maximal simultaneous property (three geometrically smooth members all attaining minimum possible degree for a plane-filling curve), not a selected arbitrary slice or a restatement of individual existence. The unique Singer orbit and the nonreduced base-scheme structure of nine residual intersection length over a Frobenius cubic orbit answer geometrically natural group-action and intersection questions, offering precise input for finite-field Bertini and characteristic-two pencil constructions. It is an exhaustive natural extremal family, not a routine equation substitution.
